title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: entry thresholds for taking a cover
content:
## Scope

This entry matrix belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. For every tier it states the cargo categories the product may cover, the insured value range, whether a cover may take fewer containers than the booking carries, whether a freight forwarder or NVOCC may hold it, the binding deadline, and the entry conditions recorded for the tier.

## Entry matrix

| Tier | Eligible cargo categories | Minimum insured value | Maximum insured value of one cover | Cover of part of the booking's containers | Forwarder or NVOCC may hold | Latest binding (calendar days before scheduled departure) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | No | Yes | 0 |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 0.00 USD | 2000000.00 USD | No | No | 1 |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | general, out of gauge | 5000.00 USD | 500000.00 USD | No | Yes | 1 |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | general, reefer, out of gauge | 5000.00 USD | 1000000.00 USD | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 10000.00 USD | 2500000.00 USD | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| AHL CargoCare Total | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 10000.00 USD | 5000000.00 USD | Yes | No | 2 |

## Entry conditions recorded for each tier

| Tier | Entry condition |
|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | Attaches automatically on cargo receipt; no premium. |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | The value is declared on the transport document; bound by the cargo owner. |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | Minimum insured value and binding deadline as in the matrix. |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | Minimum insured value and binding deadline as in the matrix. |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | Minimum insured value and binding deadline as in the matrix. |
| AHL CargoCare Total | Minimum insured value and binding deadline as in the matrix; bound by the cargo owner. |

## Definitions

- **Eligible cargo categories**: the cargo categories the product may cover.
- **Minimum insured value**: the lowest insured value for which the product may be bound, per cover.
- **Maximum insured value of one cover**: the highest insured value of one cover.
- **Cover of part of the booking's containers**: whether a cover may take fewer containers than the booking carries.
- **Forwarder or NVOCC may hold**: whether a freight forwarder or NVOCC may hold the product for its cargo owner.
- **Latest binding**: the latest binding, in calendar days before the scheduled departure.

## Points of judgement

**Can reefer cargo be covered under AHL CargoCare Essential?** No; its eligible categories are general and out of gauge only.

**Can an NVOCC hold AHL CargoCare Total for its cargo owner?** No; the matrix shows No for that tier, and the tier is bound by the cargo owner.

**A shipper wants AHL CargoCare Plus on two of the booking's five containers. Is part cover possible on that tier?** Yes; AHL CargoCare Plus shows Yes for cover of part of the booking's containers.
